translations.guide.physical.title: Individuals and relationship tree
translations.guide.physical.summary: A unified record for employees, related persons and family members.
translations.guide.physical.point1: A new record uses two short steps: identity, then relationship and validity period. Actions depend on your application permissions.
translations.guide.physical.point2: A valid national ID is required for residents and a passport number for non-residents. National ID, passport and FBA ID cannot be duplicated across active records.
translations.guide.physical.point3: Selecting ‘Immediate family member of a related person’ pre-fills and locks the business yes/no values. Selecting another basis resets and unlocks them.
translations.guide.physical.point4: The confirm icon in the table verifies a draft. After success the status refreshes immediately and the verification action disappears.
translations.guide.physical.point5: The relationship tree displays recorded family and other links for any individual, including an employee.
translations.guide.physical.point6: Excel import first validates structure, columns and each row; export downloads recorded data. Delete deactivates the record and removes it from the active view.
translations.guide.physical.point7: Four-eyes principle: the person who entered a record cannot verify it. The verify icon is disabled for the author and a tooltip explains why; another authorised user must verify it.
translations.guide.legal.title: Legal entities
translations.guide.legal.summary: Recording, verification and data exchange for related legal entities.
translations.guide.legal.point1: Name and relationship basis are required; identifiers and dates are checked against residency and business rules.
translations.guide.legal.point2: A draft can be edited, verified or deactivated. The table refreshes after every successful action.
translations.guide.legal.point3: Excel import accepts only the prescribed template and reports errors by row and column; export downloads the complete view.
translations.guide.legal.point4: Residents need a tax number (up to 13 digits) and the FBA ID is inactive; non-residents need an FBA ID (up to 10 digits) and the tax number is inactive. Valid-from is required, valid-to may stay empty.
translations.guide.legal.point5: Four-eyes principle applies here too: you cannot verify a record you entered yourself.
translations.guide.limits.title: Limits and capital
translations.guide.limits.summary: Separate screens over connected financial data.
translations.guide.limits.point1: Limits store amount, utilisation, adjustment, deadline and comment. Numeric fields reject text and disallowed negative values.
translations.guide.limits.point2: Available limit is calculated from recorded values and is not entered manually.
translations.guide.limits.point3: Capital has a separate screen for clarity, while regulatory and core capital remain connected to the same business data. Capital has its own screen and permissions; when it has not been recorded, that state is shown.
translations.guide.limits.point4: Excel export uses the data shown in the module. Deleting a limit is permanent and requires confirmation.
translations.guide.limits.point5: In the new-limit form the legal-entity list opens immediately with all entities; typing narrows the list, and the chosen entity appears as a chip that can be cleared.
translations.guide.reports.title: Regulatory reporting and period
translations.guide.reports.summary: Report generation, download and reporting-period control.
translations.guide.reports.point1: Daily and monthly reports are produced from recorded data and can be downloaded from the list after generation.
translations.guide.reports.point2: Authenticated users who are not deactivated can view and download existing reports. Without an explicit application role the effective access is Guest.
translations.guide.reports.point3: Generating a daily or monthly report permanently creates a database record. It is not a read-only action: it is allowed only for Capital and Admin through application permissions. If the download after generation fails, use the saved report instead of generating again.
translations.guide.reports.point4: Notifications show business purpose, recipients, delivery status and the time a message was recorded.
translations.guide.reports.point5: A locked period blocks business changes. An unlock request must contain a reason (10–500 characters); an administrator can approve it, request clarification (10–490 characters) or reject it with a note.
translations.guide.administration.title: Administration
translations.guide.administration.summary: Users, access, code lists and audit trail.
translations.guide.administration.point1: Keycloak is the identity source. PL, FL, Capital, Limits and Admin are application accesses stored in the database and can be combined. A signed-in user has basic Guest viewing access, and only administrators can view the audit log.
translations.guide.administration.point2: Additional access is linked to an existing identity through application records. Removing additional roles returns the user to Guest access unless the final active Admin would be lost. You cannot deactivate/delete yourself or remove the final active Admin access.
translations.guide.administration.point3: Code lists populate form choices. Active values can be selected; inactive values remain for history. The backend rejects deleting a value or entire list while business data uses it. Import has a preview and an explicit confirmation of valid rows.
translations.guide.administration.point4: The audit log shows who changed what, when and in which area, including available old and new values.
translations.guide.administration.point5: In the audit log each action has a colour: green for created, yellow for changed, red for removed. Open the details to see every field with its old and new value.
translations.guide.general.title: Working in the application
translations.guide.general.point1: Fields are checked as you type: the first problem is shown next to the field and the primary button stays disabled until everything is valid.
translations.guide.general.point2: Search is not case sensitive. Language and light or dark theme are chosen in the header and remembered.
translations.guide.general.point3: Everything works from the keyboard: Tab moves between elements, Space or Enter toggles a checkbox and opens or closes a guide section, Escape closes dialogs.
translations.guide.general.point4: Lists show the total number of records; use the page buttons below the table to move between pages.
translations.guide.before: Check required fields, identifiers, dates and business basis. The application shows a detailed message when something is invalid; data is not saved until the issue is resolved. If the outcome of saving is unknown, refresh the view before submitting again.
